The old 403 (`raise Discourse::InvalidAccess...` in `update_patch`) only guarded the PATCH membership-change path, which the diff removes entirely — the new `update` action no longer accepts membership changes at all (`group.alias_level`, `visible`, and name only, with name ignored for automatic groups: `group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic`). The claimed security regression does not exist in this diff.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the special PATCH handling in `Admin::GroupsController#update` (old `request.patch?` branch calling `update_patch` which raised `Discourse::InvalidAccess` for `group.automatic`). The new `update` method runs for both PUT and PATCH and does not raise on automatic groups; it only ignores `name` changes when `group.automatic` but still allows `alias_level`/`visible` updates and can return `success_json` (200). However, PATCH no longer performs membership changes at all (membership mutations moved to `add_members`/`remove_member` which return 422 for automatic groups), so the missing 403 is an API/behavior change rather than a clear correctness/security defect in the new intended flow.
